        Pull request overview

        This PR refactors the extension’s popup and GitHub DOM parsing into more testable, modular units, introduces typed message contracts between popup/content scripts, and adds/extends unit tests and CI checks to validate behavior.

        Changes:

        • Refactors popup logic into mountPopup() and adds unit tests for extraction/copy flows.
        • Splits GitHub DOM parsing and Markdown conversion into dedicated modules and adds parser fallback/warning coverage.
        • Updates config/tooling for ESM-friendly Vite config paths, Vitest/jsdom, and adds a CI typecheck step.

        Reviewed changes

        Copilot reviewed 13 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

        Show a summary per file
        File Description
        vite.config.ts Switches to ESM-safe root resolution and adds Vitest jsdom configuration.
        tsconfig.json Adds Node/Vitest global types for config/tests/typechecking.
        tests/popup.unit.test.ts Adds unit tests for popup controller behavior (extract/copy/error cases).
        tests/parser.unit.test.ts Adds coverage for GitHub DOM fallback selectors and “no threads” warning.
        src/shared/messages.ts Introduces typed request/response contracts and runtime type guards.
        src/popup/main.ts Replaces inline popup logic with mountPopup() wiring.
        src/popup/app.ts New dependency-injected popup controller to enable unit testing.
        src/core/types.ts Adds LineRange type shared by parsing/extraction.
        src/core/parser.ts Refactors parser to use new GitHub/Markdown helper modules and adds warnings.
        src/core/markdown.ts Extracts comment-body HTML → Markdown conversion into its own module.
        src/core/github.ts New GitHub DOM extraction utilities with broader selector fallbacks.
        src/content/index.ts Uses message type guard and adds error response handling.
        package.json Adds typecheck script and new dev deps (notably @types/node).
        package-lock.json Locks new dev dependency versions.
        .github/workflows/unit-tests.yml Adds a npm run typecheck step before tests.

        queryAll dedupes by stuffing matches into a Set and then returning Array.from(seen). When multiple selectors are used, this can return elements in selector/insertion order rather than true DOM order (e.g., a later selector might match an earlier-in-DOM node). That can reorder extracted comment blocks vs. how they appear on the PR page. Consider collecting matches and then sorting by document position (or using a single selector that matches all targets) so comment ordering remains stable and predictable.

          Copilotbot
          on Mar 15, 2026
          • Nit
          More actions

          extractCommentBlocks() already calls extractLineRange(thread) internally to stamp each extracted comment with a line range. extractFeedbackFromDocument() calls extractLineRange(thread) again just to decide whether to push a warning, which duplicates DOM querying/parsing work and risks drifting behavior if extractLineRange changes. Consider returning the computed LineRange from extractCommentBlocks (or accepting it as an argument) so the line range is computed once per thread.

            CI runs on Node 22 (unit-tests.yml), but @types/node is set to ^25.5.0. Using node typings newer than the runtime can let code typecheck against APIs that don't exist in CI/production.
